text:
leo: quick note 17: we keep getting confused between 'what we intend to pin' and 'what probes report'. need a minimal schema change so control-plane decisions don't auto-evict on noisy probes.

maya: can we make intent authoritative and make probe data advisory?

leo: yes. proposal: rollout_meta.intent = {version, ts, mode}, rollout_meta.probe_hint optional and advisory.

frank: compatibility: older SDKs can send a compact tuple like `g:42|t:1700000000`. control-plane parses if present.

maya: also add `telemetry_fresh` computed server-side (true if last_seen within window) so we only act on probes when fresh.

leo: Console should expose `stale` vs `confirmed` statuses and a CTA to "hold pin".

infra-bot: CI: please add schema bump note `x-rollout-meta-v:2` to PR.

frank: privacy: only store aggregates (active_pct, sample_count bucketed). no client IPs.

leo: agreed. i'll draft an RFC PR with a minimal TLV-compat example and migration notes. leaving thread open for reviews.
